messages:
Connor O'Brien: planning rollout for retention controls (v1) behind flags. want to lock canary strategy + monitoring checklist + comms timing today so we can hit end-of-week staged enable. owners pls confirm readiness + any gotchas.

Flags as of now (from platform):
- `retention_controls_v1` (top-level)
- `retention_policy_api_write`
- `console_retention_settings_page`
- `auditlog_retention_enforcement_worker`

Proposed sequence:
1) enable in staging (all tenants)
2) prod: internal tenants only (Redwood dogfood)
3) prod: canary 1% hosted tenants (low-volume) + 1 dedicated sandbox
4) ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100%

Timing proposal: staging today, internal tomorrow AM, 1% Thurs AM, ramp Thurs/Fri depending on metrics.

Chloe Martin: Console page is ready behind `console_retention_settings_page`. UI shows “effective policy” + last enforcement run panel. If `retention_controls_v1` is off, settings nav item stays hidden. Only thing: copy for legal hold banner is final but would love Naomi’s thumbs up.

Jada Williams: Backend endpoints are gated by `retention_policy_api_write` for PUT/PATCH. GET effective policy is safe and can be left on (but currently also behind top-level flag). RBAC checks in place (org admin only). Audit events emitted on policy changes.

Ethan Park: Control plane migrations are merged + deployed to staging already. Prod migration window: we can run it any time, it’s additive. No backfill needed for existing tenants; defaults come from code if no policy row exists.

Sean Gallagher: SRE ask: canary needs hard guardrails on enforcement worker. last time we ran delete-heavy jobs we spiked DB IO (not naming names 😅). For canary, please set:
- max delete batch size low
- per-run time budget
- rate limit on DB writes
- quick kill switch (flag off should stop new work within minutes)
Also want a monitoring checklist pasted here with the exact dashboards/alerts.

Marcus Lin: Security perspective: OK to proceed w/ staged rollout as long as (a) legal hold semantics are enforced before any deletion, (b) audit logging captures admin policy changes, and (c) we’re not marketing “customer configurable for all log streams” yet. For v1 scope, keep comms very specific.

Naomi Feldman: +1. Also: can we pick 2-3 design partners for 10% stage instead of random 10%? (at least for Dedicated). For Hosted, random is fine but I’d like a “known friendly” cohort too. Legal hold banner copy is fine; just make sure it says “Legal hold overrides retention enforcement” and links to docs.

Dev Patel: Support readiness request: pls give us 48h notice before turning on for external tenants. We need:
- FAQ snippet: “what data types are covered in v1”
- what customers will see in Console
- how to explain “last enforcement run” and what to do if it’s stale
Also confirm: exports won’t suddenly fail if enforcement is running?

Jada Williams: Exports should be fine. Exporter now adds metadata if date range extends beyond retention window (returns partial + warning header), but doesn’t hard-fail unless request is entirely outside retention. That change is already behind the same top-level flag.

Elliot Price: Docs draft is ready (Console page + API + “what’s in scope for v1”). I can publish to docs site once we’ve passed internal canary. Would prefer not to publish before we can point to stable behavior in prod.

release-bot: Deployment scheduled: control-plane@2025.01.21.3 to STAGING (includes retention policy schema + validation). (requested by Ethan Park)

Connor O'Brien: ok, assembling canary plan + checklist. pls react :thumbsup: if you’re good with this.

CANARY PLAN (prod)
A) Staging today
- enable `retention_controls_v1=true` globally in staging
- run enforcement worker in “dry-run logging” mode for 1 cycle (no deletes)

B) Internal dogfood (Wed 10am PT)
- enable for Redwood internal org/tenants only
- enable worker with real deletes BUT with conservative limits:
  - `max_rows_per_batch=500`
  - `max_batches_per_run=10`
  - `run_time_budget_sec=120`
  - `sleep_between_batches_ms=250`
  - `max_partitions_per_run=5`

C) External canary 1% (Thurs 10am PT)
- Hosted: random low-volume cohort (usage < p25)
- Dedicated: 1 sandbox + 1 design partner (Naomi to confirm acct)

D) Ramp
- 10% Thurs 2pm PT if green
- 50% Fri 10am PT if green
- 100% Fri 2pm PT if green (or push to Monday if any SRE concerns)

ROLLBACK
- flip `auditlog_retention_enforcement_worker=false` first (stop deletes)
- if needed, flip `retention_controls_v1=false` (hides UI + disables writes)
- note: existing policies remain stored but inert if top-level off

MONITORING CHECKLIST (must be green)
1) Worker health
- job success rate > 99%
- `retention_enforcement_lag_seconds` not increasing
- `retention_delete_errors_total` flat
2) Datastore safety
- DB CPU/IO within normal band (+<10% over baseline)
- lock time / slow queries not spiking
3) Customer impact
- no increase in 5xx on audit log export endpoints
- Console page load p95 stable
4) Auditability
- verify an admin policy change generates audit event
- verify “last enforcement run” timestamp updates

I’ll drop links once Sean confirms dashboard names.

Sean Gallagher: looks good. Dashboard links:
- Retention / Enforcement Overview: (Grafana) `dashboards/retention-enforcement-overview`
- Audit Log Exporter: `dashboards/audit-log-exporter`
Alerts to enable for canary:
- `RetentionEnforcementLagHigh` (warn)
- `RetentionDeleteErrorRateHigh` (page if sustained >5m)
- `AuditLogDBLoadHigh` (warn)
Also request: for internal canary, can we pin it to 2 regions first (us-east-1 + eu-west-1) before we go multi-region?

Ethan Park: We can scope worker per region via config. Control plane policy eval is region-aware but safe. I’ll set worker enablement to us-east-1 + eu-west-1 for internal stage, then expand at 1%.

Chloe Martin: :thumbsup: from Console. One more thing: if flag gets flipped off mid-session, UI will show “Settings unavailable” toast. That’s expected.

Marcus Lin: :thumbsup: Security ok. Please ensure comms don’t imply we retain inference payload content; this is logs/metadata/audit/admin activity/eligible telemetry only.

Naomi Feldman: :thumbsup: I’ll DM Connor the design partner tenant IDs by EOD. Also +1 on region scoping for early canary.

Dev Patel: :thumbsup: as long as we get the 48h heads-up + FAQ link. Also please post in #support when staging starts (so we can sanity check screenshots).

Elliot Price: :thumbsup: I’ll hold docs publish until after internal dogfood has 24h clean signal.

Connor O'Brien: great. action items:
- Ethan: region-scope worker for internal canary + confirm prod migration timing
- Sean: enable alerts for canary window + confirm thresholds
- Naomi: send design partner tenant IDs + comms copy constraints
- Dev/Elliot: sync on support-facing FAQ + docs publish timing

Comms timing:
- Today: post in #eng + #support: staging on, internal tomorrow
- Tomorrow after 2h internal: post in #sales-eng/#sales enablement: “coming Thurs, limited canary”
- External/customer-facing docs: publish after 24h internal + initial 1% green

Next checkpoint: tomorrow 9:30am PT in this thread w/ go/no-go for internal enable.
